title: China's July economy 'weakens across the board': retail, output, investment all miss — Bloomberg
summary: China's July NBS economic data missed consensus across the board: retail sales, industrial output, and fixed-asset investment all came in below estimates. Bloomberg described the result as the economy 'extending slowdown by weakening across the board,' reinforcing concerns about domestic demand and raising expectations for further stimulus.
why: 中国7月经济数据全线低于预期，彭博汇总NBS数据显示零售、工业产出、固定资产投资三项核心指标均不及市场预期，内需走弱趋势延续。直接压制港股（腾讯、美团、阿里等）及A股情绪，市场对进一步刺激政策预期升温。Bloomberg 2026-08-17发布（距今1天），与8月15日路透已收录的初步数据形成延伸报道，仍在发酵中。

title: 30-year Treasury yield hits 5.31%, highest in 19 years, as markets await FOMC July minutes Aug 19
summary: The 30-year US Treasury yield climbed to 5.31%, its highest level in 19 years, as investors position ahead of the FOMC July 28–29 meeting minutes releasing August 19 at 2 pm ET. The July meeting held rates at 3.50–3.75% on a 9-3 vote, with three dissenters (Hammack/Cleveland, Kashkari/Minneapolis, Logan/Dallas) favoring a 25 bp hike. Minutes expected to reveal depth of internal debate over the September path.
why: 30年美债收益率升至5.31%（19年新高），市场正为8月19日FOMC 7月会议纪要做预案——该次会议9-3维持利率3.50-3.75%，3票异议倾向加息。纪要将揭示9月行动的争议程度，对科技股估值压制及美股整体定价影响直接。长债收益率创新高也进一步削弱成长股估值。CNBC 2026-08-17发布。

title: Oil near $89/bbl as Hormuz shipping falls to war-time lows; IEA warns deepest supply deficit in 5 years
summary: Brent crude rose to ~$89.19/bbl (WTI ~$82.85) as tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz dropped to war-time lows, with as few as 5 vessels transiting on a recent weekend versus ~130 pre-conflict. The IEA warned the market faces its deepest supply deficit in five years. The stalemate shows no near-term resolution.
why: 霍尔木兹海峡油轮通行量跌至战时低点（近期某周末仅约5艘 vs 战前约130艘），国际能源署警告5年最深供给缺口，布伦特油价升至89美元附近。油价走高对全球通胀预期和美联储政策路径形成新压力，并影响能源相关标的定价。CNBC 2026-08-17发布。

title: Gold holds near $4,420 on two-day rally as September Fed rate-hike odds fall to ~33%
summary: Gold maintained a two-day gain near $4,420/oz, supported by a weaker dollar and soft US economic data that pushed the implied probability of a September Fed rate hike down to approximately 33%. Bloomberg identified reduced rate-hike expectations as the primary driver of the move.
why: 黄金连续两日上涨维持4,420美元/盎司附近，软性美国数据令市场对美联储9月加息预期降至约33%，美元随之走弱形成支撑。黄金创历史新高利好老铺黄金(6181.HK)等黄金标的估值重估，同时反映市场对鹰派路径的定价边际回撤。Bloomberg 2026-08-17发布。

title: Alibaba near ~$1.5B+ deal to sell Lingxi Games to Trustar Capital in AI-pivot asset sale (Reuters confirmed Aug 17)
summary: Alibaba is selling its Lingxi Games unit — comprising five game studios including 9Game and the flagship title 'Three Kingdoms: Strategy Edition' — to Trustar Capital in a deal initially reported by Bloomberg at ~$1.5 billion. Reuters confirmed the deal on August 17. The divestiture reflects Alibaba's strategic refocus on AI and cloud, shedding non-core gaming assets.
why: 阿里巴巴出售旗下灵犀互娱(5个游戏工作室，含《三国志·战略版》旗舰产品)给Trustar Capital，Bloomberg 8月14日首报约15亿美元近交易消息，Reuters 8月17日予以确认。剥离游戏资产是阿里聚焦AI+云的战略转型信号，直接影响9988.HK及BABA估值重估预期。Bloomberg发布于8/14（距今4天），Reuters 8/17确认，仍在影响市场定价。

title: Nvidia stock 'coming alive': 3 catalysts heading into Aug 26 Q2 earnings — hyperscaler capex, Vera Rubin ramp, inference demand
summary: CNBC identified three reasons Nvidia's rally can continue ahead of Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26: (1) accelerating hyperscaler data center capex; (2) Vera Rubin GPU platform beginning to ramp; (3) AI inference demand sustaining purchase cycles beyond training. Street consensus for Q2 revenue is ~$91.8B (+96% YoY).
why: 英伟达股价近期走强，CNBC 8月17日梳理三大持续催化剂：超大型云厂商数据中心资本开支加速、Vera Rubin平台量产爬坡、AI推理需求支撑持续采购。Q2财报定于8月26日，共识预期收入918亿美元(YoY+96%)。本文角度(三大催化剂分析)与已收录的8月16日CNBC(ddaa9fd457398802)所述'两大催化剂'(英伟达+Jackson Hole)不同，互补而非重复。CNBC 2026-08-17发布。
